findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "finance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_financials, treasury_yield_curve, get_fx_rates, get_live_fx_rates, get_token_price, get_dex_price_candles, validate_identifier, get_public_holidays, check_sanctions, compare_funding_rates, rank_funding_carry, get_macro_snapshot, get_local_crypto_premiums, get_lending_yields · Private data: get_token_price · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, sec_financials · Destructive: validate_identifier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sec_financials, treasury_yield_curve, get_fx_rates, get_live_fx_rates, get_token_price, get_dex_price_candles, validate_identifier, get_public_holidays, check_sanctions, compare_funding_rates, rank_funding_carry, get_macro_snapshot, get_local_crypto_premiums, get_lending_yields · Private data: get_token_price · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, sec_financials · Destructive: validate_identifier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
